The 1944–45 season was [[List of Real Madrid CF seasons|Real Madrid Club de Fútbol's 42nd season]] in existence and the club's [[La Liga|13th consecutive season]] in the top flight of Spanish football.

==Summary==
The club finished second in the league, just one point below champions CF Barcelona<ref>{{Cite web |date=31 March 2018 |title=Memories of Sevilla 1946 Champion |url=https://sevilla.abc.es/orgullodenervion/noticias-sevilla-fc/sevi-recuerdo-del-sevilla-al-equipo-campeon-liga-1946-201803311454_noticia.html |access-date=30 November 2020 |website=ABC |language=Spanish |location=Seville, Spain}}</ref> under management of Ramon Encinas.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.marca.com/blogs/ni-mas-ni-menos/2020/02/15/ramon-encinas-una-vida-pegado-a-un.html|title=Ramon Encinas A Life as Coach|work=Marca|location=Spain|date=15 February 2020|accessdate=2 December 2020|language=Spanish}}</ref> The team remained in contention for the title until match day 21, when archrivals Barcelona defeated Madrid 5–0 and shattered its chances to reclaim the championship.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.lainformacion.com/deporte/la-octava-manita-en-un-real-madrid-barcelona_pvbwffnq4xhyjktsosfqm/|title=The Eight 'Manita' in El Clásico|publisher=lainformacion.com|date=13 April 2011|accessdate=20 November 2020|language=Spanish}}</ref> The squad reached the Copa del Generalísimo round of 16 after defeating SD Ceuta,<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.lavanguardia.com/deportes/futbol/20121031/54353691906/copa-del-rey-alcoyano-real-madrid-batalla-del-agua.html|title=The Battle of the Water|work=La Vanguardia|date=31 October 2012|accessdate=30 November 2020|language=Spanish}}</ref> but was eliminated in a playoff (tiebreaker) match by Sevilla.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://as.com/futbol/2013/01/09/copa_del_rey/1357770829_300022.html|publisher=as.com|title=8–7 Real Madrid against Valencia|date=9 January 2013|accessdate=20 November 2020}}</ref> Barinaga scored and Pruden added two goals.

On 27 October 1944, the club started the construction of the [[Santiago Bernabéu Stadium|new stadium]] at Chamartín.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.abc.es/espana/madrid/abci-santiago-bernabeu-estadio-monumental-nacio-descampado-201610120003_noticia.html|title=The Santiago Bernabéu, A Colossal Stadium|work=ABC|location=Spain|date=12 October 2016|accessdate=2 December 2020|language=Spanish}}</ref>
